title: Representative normalization predicate for derived tensor constraints
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,R)$ be a ringed site small relative to the universe of ordinary $R$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $R$ commutative. Write $D(R)$ for their unbounded derived category, $Q$ for cochain localization and $[a]$ for integer cochain shifts [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal P$ be the full category of K-flat complexes with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Write $T(E,F)$ for the signed direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and fix the actual derived tensor bifunctor $B$ and representative isomorphisms $r_{E,F}:QT(E,F)\cong B(QE,QF)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. The bundled total and shift models use the resolving closure assertions of [lem-pur-kflat-total-tensor-model], [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated].

Define bifunctors $B^{a,b}_{\rm in}(X,Y)=B(X[a],Y[b])$, $B^{a,b}_{\rm out}(X,Y)=B(X,Y)[a+b]$, $B^{\rm op}(X,Y)=B(Y,X)$, and trifunctors $B_L((X,Y),Z)=B(B(X,Y),Z)$ and $B_R((X,Y),Z)=B(X,B(Y,Z))$. Define $\ell_{E,F,G}:QT(T(E,F),G)\cong B_L((QE,QF),QG)$ by $r_{T(E,F),G}$ followed by $B(r_{E,F},1)$, and $\rho_{E,F,G}:QT(E,T(F,G))\cong B_R((QE,QF),QG)$ by $r_{E,T(F,G)}$ followed by $B(1,r_{F,G})$.

For integers $a,b$, let $c_{E,F}^{a,b}:T(E[a],F[b])\cong T(E,F)[a+b]$ extract the second shift $b$ first and the first shift $a$ second, followed by the canonical shift-addition identification; the first extraction has coefficient $(-1)^{bp}$ in shifted first-factor degree $p$ and the second is unsigned. Define $s_{E,F}^{a,b}:B(QE[a],QF[b])\cong B(QE,QF)[a+b]$ as the composite of the inverse localization shift comparisons, $r_{E[a],F[b]}^{-1}$, $Q(c_{E,F}^{a,b})$, the localization shift comparison for $T(E,F)$, and $r_{E,F}[a+b]$.

For given natural isomorphisms $t_{a,b}:B^{a,b}_{\rm in}\cong B^{a,b}_{\rm out}$, $\alpha:B_L\cong B_R$, and $\sigma:B\cong B^{\rm op}$, define $\operatorname{IsNormalized}(t,\alpha,\sigma)$ to be the conjunction of the following three equalities for all resolving inputs and all integers $a,b$: $t_{a,b}(QE,QF)=s_{E,F}^{a,b}$; $\alpha((QE,QF),QG)=\rho_{E,F,G}\circ Q(A_{E,F,G})\circ\ell_{E,F,G}^{-1}$, where $A$ is unsigned total reassociation; and $\sigma(QE,QF)=r_{F,E}\circ Q(\beta_{E,F})\circ r_{E,F}^{-1}$, where $\beta$ is the Koszul total braiding with coefficient $(-1)^{pq}$ in original degrees $(p,q)$. This is a predicate on the specified natural isomorphisms, with no existence, uniqueness, additivity, faithfulness or boundedness assertion.
